newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen higher after inflation data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen higher after inflation data.

text.p: U.S. stocks are likely to open higher on Wednesday after the release of a lower-than-expected January consumer price index, analysts said.

U.S. consumer prices edged up slightly in January, the Labor Department said on Wednesday, offering further evidence that inflation remained largely contained as the U.S. economic expansion approaches its sixth birthday.
The department said the consumer price index rose only 0.1 percent, the smallest monthly increase since last summer, after rising 0.3 percent in December.

"It should be positive today but the market was up 78 points yesterday. So it's kind of hard to say how much of this already in there. But it certainly provides a good backdrop," said Guy Truicko, equity portfolio manager at Unity Management.
